seo.title: Avesta Tech | Audit-ready evidence for secure software
seo.description: Turn code scans into signed, audit-ready evidence for ISO 27001, IEC 62443 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Software quality and testing from Utrecht.

sections.heading: Proof, not promises.
sections.sub: Avesta Tech turns your code scans and tests into audit-ready evidence for ISO/IEC 27001, IEC 62443-4-1 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Signed, checkable, and with a fix for every finding.
sections.micro: 8 questions · 3 minutes · no sign-up needed. Your code never leaves your machines.

sections.heading: Regulation is here. Your scanner still only gives you a list.

items.title: The CRA is live
items.body: Reporting duties under the EU Cyber Resilience Act started on 11 September 2026. The rest applies from 11 December 2027.*

items.title: Lists are not proof
items.body: Developer scanners list bugs. They do not answer the auditor's question: "Can you prove it?"

items.title: Reports go stale
items.body: A consultant's answer costs a lot and is out of date a month later. Your product keeps changing.

sections.footnote: * Dates and amounts: verify with counsel.

sections.heading: One company. Two ways to work with us.

items.title: The evidence engine for software regulation.
items.body: Scan a repository, get a verdict per control in three standards, a signed report, an SBOM and a CRA technical-file draft. Every week, in your own CI.

items.title: Quality work, done properly and at a fixed price.
items.body: Readiness scans, test automation, accessibility audits and AI assistant testing, delivered by engineers who have built software for high-tech machines.

sections.heading: From commit to evidence in four steps.

steps.title: Scan.
steps.body: Eight scanners check code, dependencies, secrets, complexity, tests and repository hygiene.

steps.title: Prioritise.
steps.body: Findings that attackers are using right now (CISA KEV) come first, then likelihood (EPSS), then severity.

steps.title: Map.
steps.body: Each finding is tied to the controls it affects in ISO/IEC 27001, IEC 62443-4-1 and the CRA.

steps.title: Prove.
steps.body: The report is signed and linked into a tamper-evident history your auditor can check offline.

sections.heading: Everything an auditor asks for. Nothing they have to take on trust.

items.title: Verdict per control
items.body: Pass, partial, warn or fail for every mapped control, with the exact fix per finding.

items.title: Exploit-aware priority
items.body: "These 2 of your 140 findings are being used in attacks right now." Start there.

items.title: Signed and chained
items.body: Ed25519 signatures and a hash-chained ledger. Edit an old report and the check fails.

items.title: Evidence that expires
items.body: Pen tests, threat models and accepted risks carry an end date, so nothing quietly goes stale.

items.title: CRA technical file
items.body: A draft structured on Annex VII, built from real scan data, plus a CycloneDX SBOM.

items.title: Trust page and badge
items.body: A one-page trust statement to answer customer security questionnaires faster.

sections.heading: We would rather show "partial" than pretend.
paragraphs: If a scanner did not run, the controls it covers are marked partial. Never a silent pass. If a manual check has expired, it turns red. That is what makes the evidence worth something.

sections.heading: Three standards. One scan.
paragraphs: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A · IEC 62443-4-1 · EU Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847)
sections.note: Mappings are indicative and reviewed against the current standard text. Avesta produces audit-ready evidence; certification comes from accredited bodies.

sections.heading: Built for teams that ship regulated software.

items.title: Connected-product makers.
items.body: Industrial IoT, building automation, energy, medical devices and automotive suppliers facing the CRA and IEC 62443.

items.title: B2B software companies.
items.body: Answer enterprise ISO 27001 evidence requests without a two-week scramble.

items.title: Consultancies and audit partners.
items.body: One repeatable evidence tool for every client.
